title: You shall be Visible!
description: Skellies Goto Torches! And you got more fun soul torches that let you move skeletons, too op but eh, for fun (datapack) for feedback goto toomanyskellies@gmail.com
body:
# Recommended Mods for Pairing
For the best experience, pair this datapack with these other great mods:

Torch Hit! - Allows you to fight back by setting mobs on fire with your torch.

Soul Fire'd - Makes the soul torch's "remote control" also burn mobs with soul fire.

LambDynamicLights - Lets you see the light you're emitting, so you can spot incoming skeletons.
## Disclaimer
This datapack is *not* affiliated with **LambdAurora**, **Crystal Nest**, or **Crystal Spider**. It's designed to work *alongside* their mods for more fun! **Features**: (Obvious) This datapack is new, but if you want skeletons to know you have your torch and to make Minecraft harder, use this! 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

This makes it so you can herd skeletons with soul torches (to make them useful and not only for building in the Soul Sand Valley). It just means the soul torch grabs up to 5 skeletons and you can place them anywhere. But if you want to easily kill 'em, just pull them into the ground and watch them suffer from suffocation and get clapped 😈.

</details>



Also, the normal torch just makes skeletons go to you, so it's more realistic—they always find you. (They come from a specific direction I Forgot??; just the limitations of datapacks, but still!)

 Use this for more skeleton encounters! If you have any feedback, it is genuinely appreciated. For Feedback goto toomanyskellies@gmail.com to give ideas, and feedback
